# Khronos EnvironmentTest fixture

`glTF-IBL/EnvironmentTest.gltf` is copied from KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets:

https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/EnvironmentTest

The fixture is used for renderer regressions that need an official `EXT_lights_image_based`
asset shape. Binary and image payloads are stubbed by the tests.
